stats.cell_count_note: standard cells excluding fill/decap and tap cells

sources.note: ORFS 6_report.json / 6_final.sdc of the run that wrote the GDS win; the pd summary only fills values they lack

pd_summary_values.clock: clock period **7.20 ns**, setup WNS 0.031 ns, hold WNS 0.436 ns (baseline 7.00 ns, WNS 0.066 ns).

redundancy.method: flip-flops = DEF components whose master matches sky130_fd_sc_hd__{,e,s,se}df*; group/copy from the instance name (docs/SPEC.md section 7); bit index from the instance name after the copy token, else from the Q net name (mod register width); distances between placed cell boxes (DEF PLACED + LEF SIZE): centre-to-centre and edge-to-edge gap
redundancy.placement_constraints_note: The routed DEF carries 5 placement fences (DEF REGIONS, TYPE FENCE: pdsep_copyA, pdsep_copyB, pdsep_th0, pdsep_th1, pdsep_th2) with their GROUPS; the pd flow (pd/sky130hd_sep/config.mk) created them to keep the redundant copies apart.

baseline.note: unconstrained baseline run (no placement fences), same RTL and die

cells.rect: uint16 x0,y0,x1,y1 per cell on the layer grid (DEF PLACED origin + LEF SIZE)

clkbuf_1.desc: balanced-rise/fall buffer used in the clock tree (also used as an ordinary buffer)

clkdlybuf4s50_1.desc: 4-stage clock delay buffer (slow, used as a delay or port buffer)

conb_1.desc: constant driver: HI is tied to VPWR, LO to VGND

dfxtp_1.desc: positive-edge-triggered D flip-flop (one bit of storage)
dfxtp_1.eq: Q <= D on the rising CLK edge

diode_2.desc: diode on a long net; drains plasma-etch charge so thin gate oxide is not damaged (no logic)

fa_1.eq: SUM = A ^ B ^ CIN; COUT = majority(A, B, CIN)

fa_2.eq: SUM = A ^ B ^ CIN; COUT = majority(A, B, CIN)

fill_1.desc: filler cell: continues the wells and power rails in an empty row slot (no logic)

fill_2.desc: filler cell: continues the wells and power rails in an empty row slot (no logic)

fill_4.desc: filler cell: continues the wells and power rails in an empty row slot (no logic)

fill_8.desc: filler cell: continues the wells and power rails in an empty row slot (no logic)

ha_1.eq: SUM = A ^ B; COUT = A & B

ha_2.eq: SUM = A ^ B; COUT = A & B

ha_4.eq: SUM = A ^ B; COUT = A & B

tapvpwrvgnd_1.desc: well-tap cell: ties the n-well to VPWR and the p-substrate to VGND (latch-up protection, no logic)

parts.method: Step 1 instance names (kept orbit_keep_reg copies, CTS/resizer/physical-cell prefixes and masters); step 2 netlist cones from the DEF NETS section for the anonymous synthesis cells: forward sinks (flip-flop groups via D, output ports) and backward sources (flip-flop groups via Q, input ports) through combinational cells, then first-match rules (adder A/B, multiplier, comparator, OR tree, thermal voter/next-state, reset, control, other). See viz/README.md.

glb.units: 1 unit = 1 um; +X = layout x, +Y = up, -Z = layout y; origin at the die centre, z = 0 at the substrate surface

glb.part_tiles: Parts: one box per placed cell footprint from z -0.2 to 0 um (display only)
